newsitem.title: UK: Allied declines detail on portfolio change.
newsitem.headline: Allied declines detail on portfolio change.

text.p: Allied Domecq Plc declined to give further detail on Thursday on adjustments it is making to its pubs portfolio.
"We are not giving any more detail. We may make a statement on completion, possibly next week, but there's nothing further to add at this stage," a spokeswoman said.
A report in the Independent newspaper said the group was expected to sell more than 100 pubs to raise 12 million stg. Allied shares were 9p higher at 427p, having touched 432p.
But analysts said a sale of that size would not move the price. Dealers attributed the price rise buying the stock, which had been trading just above its low for the year of 407p.
Earlier, Allied Domecq confirmed it was adjusting its portfolio and said it would give more details later.
"We are in the process of doing something. We are buying and selling all the time, improving the portfolio of our estate," said the spokeswoman.
